name: Godsibb (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
It is good to have a priest in the family. Godsibbs are localized inquisitors who assert dominance over a community by controlling the flow of information and misinformation.

Often, godsibbs are given as “gifts” to a church from a wealthy and influential household. With a strong emphasis on familial structuring, a godsibb inquisitor gravitates to the role of “parent” of the party, rather than “face”.

Godparent

A godsibb must select the Community domain and the Family subdomain. In addition, a godsibb adds rumormonger to her list of spells known as a 1st level spell.

This alters domain.

Discern Next of Kin (Sp)

A godsibb can use discern next of kin as a spell-like ability at will.

This replaces monster lore.

Gossip (Ex)

At 12th level, a godsibb gains the rumormonger advanced rogue talent, even if she does not meet the requirements.

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 12th level.
